from pathlib import Path
import shutil
p=Path('/etc/netplan/40-cx7.yaml')
s=p.read_text()
assert s.count('10.34.')==2
backup=Path('/root/spark3-tp3-revalidation-20261003')
backup.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assert not (backup/'40-cx7.yaml').exists()
shutil.copy2(p,backup/'40-cx7.yaml')
p.write_text(s.replace('10.34.','10.13.').replace('dgx3-dgx4','dgx1-dgx3'))
print(p.read_text())
